latestHistory.note: 2026-09-26: verified production-sequence progress at published HEAD 24cd30e309ca191181482b7525d3eac6aebb4fbf, implementation source 420219d278ae17f42a04871c6319ecf62a4af216. Production sequences append an ordered list of one to five existing projects to up to 128 owned hearth queues in stable hearth ID order. Every accepted ordinary queue command spends its normal coin immediately from the shared treasury; a refusal stops that hearth while later hearths continue. Paid prefixes and existing queues remain intact. Complete hearths leave the selection; partial/refused hearths remain with exact results for manual review. Up to 24 named production templates persist in a separate browser/origin-local library; choosing and explicit Recall issue no orders, and Apply remains separate. Personal templates are excluded from campaign exports; the applied canonical queues survive save, replay and portable export/import. Storage failure, uncertain worker results and post-payment worker failure are surfaced without automatic retry or false rollback; saved-campaign recovery locks uncertain orders. Final publication verification passes 1,977 headless tests across 247 files, 30 affected Chromium journeys and 32 local production Pages journeys. 32 live Pages journeys passed in one complete final run. Earlier live evidence remains retained: the initial run had 27 passes and five failures; its unchanged five-case focused rerun had four passes and one remaining deployment-assets failure. Neither earlier attempt is described as a clean 32/32 pass. These are separate suite scopes, not additive test totals. Rules/save 32 and content 015468d1 remain unchanged. No simulation rule, AI policy or campaign price changed; no new pacing result is claimed. Evidence: ~/Work/Theandril/docs/development/2026-09-26-production-sequences/. ACT-32 and M3 remain in progress. Theaters, patrol/escort roles, army-order templates, broader governor decisions and combined mature-realm acceptance remain open. Standing repeat production, refunds/reordering and automatic retries are not delivered. All 15 release gates remain open.
